name: Visbaroness (Human Expert 4)
body:
A tremendous woman, both in size and personality, the Visbaronetess’ eyes show the passage of years that her alabaster skin and traditionally thick makeup conceal.

Human Expert 4
CR 2

XP 600
Female human expert 4
CE Medium humanoid (human)
Init -1; Senses Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 9, touch 9, flat-footed 9
hp 22 (4d8+4)
Fort +1, Ref +0, Will +5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee unarmed strike +0 (1d3+1 nonlethal)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 8, Con 11, Int 11, Wis 12, Cha 14
Base Atk +3; CMB +4; CMD 13
Feats Skill Focus (Bluff), Skill Focus (Perform [sing]), Toughness
Skills Bluff +12, Diplomacy +9, Knowledge (nobility) +7, Linguistics +7, Perform (act) +9, Perform (sing) +12, Sense Motive +8
Languages Common, Dwarven, Infernal, +2 additional
Gear fine clothes and jewelry worth 2,000 gp
